result.edit: Fix case selector literals: the 2'h hex literals collapse (2'h10 truncates to 0 and 2'h11 to 1 in a 2-bit width), creating duplicate case items and making sel=2 and sel=3 fall through so out holds its stale value. Use 2'b binary literals so sel values 00,01,10,11 map to a,b,c,d respectively.
